title: Accounts: log refusal reasons, hinted session lookup for identities/me, retry transient identity writes
description:
Ryan-approved hardening of the central accounts service (accounts/).

1. Refusal logging: one structured JSON log line per refused request — {event:accounts.refusal, route, status, code, message} for AccountsError and {event:accounts.unavailable, route, errorName, errorCode?} for unexpected errors. No tokens, subjects, emails, names or raw paths; account IDs become {account}. Motivating incident: a Shipped reader sign-in refused with 401 challenge_invalid that was invisible in logs.

2. Hinted session lookup: GET /v1/identities/me and the person-directory lookup stop scanning every stored session. Enrollment additionally writes an immutable session-lookups/<aliasKey>/<digest>.json keyed by (binding, authTime, lineageHash); a hinted find reads it and verifies the full committed chain. Older sessions fall back to the scan, which now stops at the first matching session. Google-direct lookups pass only the binding and stop at the first committed session with it. Caller answers (provenance/sessions/reenrollment_required) stay identical.

3. Transient identity write retry: concurrent identical requests surface Virtuus 'uncertain'/'unavailable' (another execution owns the operation) as 503. Operation-keyed identity writes now retry a bounded 3 attempts with jittered backoff; conflict, operation_mismatch, challenge_replay and identity_conflict are never retried.

Acceptance: specs in accounts/*.feature, tests in accounts/*.test.ts, full accounts suite + lint + typecheck green; one PR to main, not merged.
